prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Hawaiian, in her mid 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut, real pores, real living eyes, 200 clicker rings piercings set with rubies in silver-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver a bracelet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 31% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 52% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 67% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 50s goddess, latina curves physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, curtain bangs long straight hair sweeping past the shoulders — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 3 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 20% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 73% of the way down her figure from the top and about 32% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 38% of the way down her figure from the top and about 22% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is the round patch centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top and about 55% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries solid polished rose-quartz stone fused directly into her own form, soft natural veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING soft pink stone surface with VIVID white vein striations. The patch edges are hazy and feathered — there is no visible outline at all. Around each patch, a transition zone about a hand's width wide lets the patch's material and the background material dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme latina curves silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

THREE completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 4:5 aspect ratio.
